en: {dir} move
pt-BR: {dir} mover
notes: Button hint along the bottom of the game. Very short: three hints share one line.
fr: {dir} bouger
de: {dir} bewegen
pl: {dir} ruch
es: {dir} mover
ru: {dir} ход
tr: {dir} hareket
ja: {dir}移動
zh-CN: {dir}移动
ko: {dir} 이동

en: {swap} + {dir} swap
pt-BR: {swap} + {dir} trocar
notes: Button hint: hold swap and press a direction.
fr: {swap} + {dir} échanger
de: {swap} + {dir} tauschen
pl: {swap} + {dir} zamiana
es: {swap} + {dir} cambiar
ru: {swap} + {dir} обмен
tr: {swap} + {dir} takas
ja: {swap}+{dir}入れ替え
zh-CN: {swap} + {dir}交换
ko: {swap} + {dir} 바꾸기

en: {info} info
pt-BR: {info} info
notes: Button hint: open info mode.
fr: {info} info
de: {info} info
pl: {info} info
es: {info} info
ru: {info} инфо
tr: {info} bilgi
ja: {info}情報
zh-CN: {info}信息
ko: {info} 정보

en: This is a match 3 game.
pt-BR: Este é um jogo de combinar 3.
notes: First-dive intro, big text centered on screen, one line.
fr: C'est un jeu de match 3.
de: Das ist ein Match-3-Spiel.
pl: To gra typu „połącz 3”.
es: Esto es un juego de combinar 3.
ru: Это игра «три в ряд».
tr: Bu bir 3’lü eşleştirme oyunu.
ja: これは3マッチゲームです。
zh-CN: 这是一款三消游戏。
ko: 이건 3매치 게임이에요.

en: Take your time.
pt-BR: Sem pressa.
notes: First-dive intro, one line.
fr: Prends ton temps.
de: Lass dir Zeit.
pl: Nie spiesz się.
es: Tómate tu tiempo.
ru: Не торопись.
tr: Acele etme.
ja: ゆっくりどうぞ。
zh-CN: 慢慢来。
ko: 천천히 하세요.

en: Soak it in.
pt-BR: Absorva tudo.
notes: First-dive intro, one line. A water pun: absorb it / soak.
fr: Imprègne-toi.
de: Lass es sacken.
pl: Zanurz się w tym.
es: Empápate bien.
ru: Пропитайся этим.
tr: İyice sindir.
ja: じっくりひたって。
zh-CN: 好好泡一泡，细细体会。
ko: 푹 젖어 보세요.

en: Use {info} to get more information.
pt-BR: Use {info} para saber mais.
notes: First-dive intro, one line. {info} is the info button icon.
fr: Utilise {info} pour en savoir plus.
de: Mit {info} erfährst du mehr.
pl: Użyj {info}, by dowiedzieć się więcej.
es: Usa {info} para obtener más información.
ru: Жми {info}, чтобы узнать больше.
tr: Daha fazla bilgi için {info} kullan.
ja: {info}でくわしい情報を見られます。
zh-CN: 用{info}获取更多信息。
ko: {info}로 더 많은 정보를 볼 수 있어요.

en: Breathe, now.
pt-BR: Agora, respire.
notes: First-dive intro, one line.
fr: Respire, maintenant.
de: Und jetzt: atmen.
pl: A teraz oddychaj.
es: Respira, ahora.
ru: А теперь дыши.
tr: Şimdi nefes al.
ja: さあ、深呼吸。
zh-CN: 现在，呼吸。
ko: 자, 숨 쉬세요.

en: Hold {swap} and push {dir} to swap.
pt-BR: Segure {swap} e aperte {dir} para trocar.
notes: Tutorial caption over the first tiny board (three seahorses and a crab). One line, 32 px high, shrinks to fit 340 px. {swap} and {dir} are button icons: hold the swap button and press a direction.
fr: Maintiens {swap} et pousse {dir} pour échanger.
de: Halte {swap} und drücke {dir} zum Tauschen.
pl: Przytrzymaj {swap} i wciśnij {dir}, by zamienić.
es: Mantén {swap} y pulsa {dir} para cambiar.
ru: Зажми {swap} и нажми {dir}, чтобы поменять.
tr: Takaslamak için {swap} basılı tut ve {dir} it.
ja: {swap}を押したまま{dir}で入れ替え。
zh-CN: 按住{swap}再推{dir}来交换。
ko: {swap}을 누른 채 {dir}을 눌러 바꿔요.

en: You can move around for free.
pt-BR: Mover-se não custa nada.
notes: Tutorial caption over the second tiny board: moving the cursor costs no moves and does not break the multiplier, only swaps count. One line, 32 px high, shrinks to fit 340 px.
fr: Te déplacer ne coûte rien.
de: Bewegen kostet nichts.
pl: Poruszanie się nic nie kosztuje.
es: Moverte por el tablero es gratis.
ru: Двигаться можно бесплатно.
tr: Etrafta bedavaya dolaşabilirsin.
ja: 動きまわるのはタダ。
zh-CN: 移动光标是免费的。
ko: 돌아다니는 건 공짜예요.

en: Fish do not need to be in straight lines.
pt-BR: Os peixes não precisam estar em linha reta.
notes: Tutorial caption over the third tiny board, where the only match is an L-shaped group: any touching group of 3 pops, whatever its shape. One line, 32 px high, shrinks to fit 340 px.
fr: Les poissons n'ont pas besoin d'être alignés.
de: Fische müssen nicht in einer geraden Linie liegen.
pl: Ryby nie muszą stać w prostej linii.
es: Los peces no tienen que estar en línea recta.
ru: Рыбам не обязательно стоять в линию.
tr: Balıkların düz sıra olması gerekmez.
ja: 魚はまっすぐ並ばなくてもいい。
zh-CN: 鱼不需要排成直线。
ko: 물고기가 일직선일 필요는 없어요.

en: A swap that pops nothing costs multiplier.
pt-BR: Uma troca que não estoura nada custa multiplicador.
notes: Tutorial line under the second tiny board, and again after any swap there that pops no fish: such a swap lowers the multiplier. One line, 16 px high, shrinks to fit 340 px.
fr: Un échange qui ne fait rien éclater coûte du multiplicateur.
de: Ein Tausch, der nichts platzen lässt, kostet Multiplikator.
pl: Zamiana, która nic nie zbija, kosztuje mnożnik.
es: Un cambio que no explota nada cuesta multiplicador.
ru: Обмен впустую стоит множителя.
tr: Hiçbir şey patlatmayan takas çarpandan yer.
ja: 何もはじけない入れ替えは倍率が下がる。
zh-CN: 什么都没消除的交换会降低倍率。
ko: 아무것도 안 터지는 바꾸기는 배수를 잃어요.

en: Remember, the ocean is mysterious.
pt-BR: Lembre-se: o oceano é misterioso.
notes: Tutorial caption over a single seahorse that turns around, rolls over, shimmers and swaps into empty water: a hint that upgrades do strange things. One line, 32 px high, shrinks to fit 340 px.
fr: Souviens-toi, l'océan est mystérieux.
de: Denk dran: Der Ozean ist geheimnisvoll.
pl: Pamiętaj, ocean jest tajemniczy.
es: Recuerda: el océano es misterioso.
ru: Помни: океан полон тайн.
tr: Unutma, okyanus gizemlidir.
ja: 忘れないで、海は不思議なところ。
zh-CN: 记住，大海是神秘的。
ko: 기억하세요, 바다는 신비로워요.

en: You cannot lose.
pt-BR: Você não pode perder.
notes: Big centered line near the end of the tutorial. One line, 32 px high, shrinks to fit 530 px.
fr: Tu ne peux pas perdre.
de: Du kannst nicht verlieren.
pl: Nie możesz przegrać.
es: No puedes perder.
ru: Проиграть нельзя.
tr: Kaybedemezsin.
ja: 負けることはありません。
zh-CN: 你不会输。
ko: 질 수는 없어요.

en: Get through {$rounds} rounds in as few moves as possible.
pt-BR: Passe por {$rounds} rodadas com o menor número de jogadas possível.
notes: Big centered line after intro.line.nolose: the goal of the game. {$rounds} is the length of the game: 5, 30 or 60. Moves are swaps. One line, 32 px high, shrinks to fit 530 px.
fr: Termine {$rounds} manches en aussi peu de coups que possible.
de: Schaffe {$rounds} Runden mit so wenigen Zügen wie möglich.
pl: Przejdź {$rounds} rund w jak najmniejszej liczbie ruchów.
es: Supera {$rounds} rondas en el menor número de jugadas posible.
ru: Пройди раунды за как можно меньше ходов. Раундов: {$rounds}.
tr: {$rounds} turu olabildiğince az hamlede bitir.
ja: {$rounds}ラウンドを、なるべく少ない手数でクリアしよう。
zh-CN: 用尽量少的步数通过{$rounds}个回合。
ko: {$rounds}라운드를 최대한 적은 이동으로 통과하세요.

en: Hi again.
pt-BR: Olá de novo.
notes: Big centered line, the first of a few just before the first upgrade screen of a player's first game. One line, 32 px high.
fr: Re-bonjour.
de: Hallo nochmal.
pl: Witaj ponownie.
es: Hola otra vez.
ru: Снова привет.
tr: Yine merhaba.
ja: また会ったね。
zh-CN: 又见面了。
ko: 또 만났네요.

en: You finished the first round.
pt-BR: Você terminou a primeira rodada.
notes: Big centered line after intro.line.hi, before the first upgrade screen. One line, 32 px high, shrinks to fit 530 px.
fr: Tu as fini la première manche.
de: Du hast die erste Runde geschafft.
pl: Pierwsza runda za tobą.
es: Terminaste la primera ronda.
ru: Первый раунд пройден.
tr: İlk turu bitirdin.
ja: 最初のラウンドが終わりました。
zh-CN: 你完成了第一回合。
ko: 첫 라운드를 끝냈어요.

en: Now you may select an upgrade.
pt-BR: Agora você pode escolher uma melhoria.
notes: Big centered line after intro.line.round1, right before the upgrade screen comes up. One line, 32 px high, shrinks to fit 530 px.
fr: Tu peux maintenant choisir une amélioration.
de: Jetzt darfst du ein Upgrade wählen.
pl: Teraz możesz wybrać ulepszenie.
es: Ahora puedes elegir una mejora.
ru: Теперь можно выбрать улучшение.
tr: Şimdi bir yükseltme seçebilirsin.
ja: 強化を1つ選べます。
zh-CN: 现在你可以选一个升级。
ko: 이제 업그레이드를 고를 수 있어요.

en: Keep playing to learn more about different upgrades.
pt-BR: Continue jogando para conhecer outras melhorias.
notes: Big centered line, the last before the first upgrade screen. One line, 32 px high, shrinks to fit 530 px.
fr: Continue à jouer pour découvrir d'autres améliorations.
de: Spiel weiter, um mehr über die verschiedenen Upgrades zu erfahren.
pl: Graj dalej, by poznać różne ulepszenia.
es: Sigue jugando para descubrir más mejoras.
ru: Играй дальше, чтобы узнать больше об улучшениях.
tr: Farklı yükseltmeleri öğrenmek için oynamaya devam et.
ja: 遊ぶうちに、いろいろな強化がわかってきます。
zh-CN: 继续玩，了解更多不同的升级。
ko: 계속 플레이하며 여러 업그레이드를 알아 가세요.

en: Good job!
pt-BR: Bom trabalho!
notes: Smaller line under intro.line.round1 ("You finished the first round."), just before the first upgrade screen. One line, 16 px high, shrinks to fit 530 px.
fr: Bien joué !
de: Gut gemacht!
pl: Dobra robota!
es: ¡Buen trabajo!
ru: Молодчина!
tr: Aferin!
ja: よくできました!
zh-CN: 干得好！
ko: 잘했어요!

en: Remember,
pt-BR: Lembre-se,
fr: Souviens-toi,
de: Denk dran:
pl: Pamiętaj,
es: Recuerda:
ru: Помни:
tr: Unutma,
ja: 忘れないで、
zh-CN: 记住，
ko: 기억하세요,

en: The ocean is mysterious.
pt-BR: O oceano é misterioso.
fr: L'océan est mystérieux.
de: Der Ozean ist geheimnisvoll.
pl: Ocean jest tajemniczy.
es: El océano es misterioso.
ru: Океан полон тайн.
tr: Okyanus gizemlidir.
ja: 海は不思議なところ。
zh-CN: 大海是神秘的。
ko: 바다는 신비로워요.

en: Fill this bar to finish the round.
pt-BR: Encha esta barra para terminar a rodada.
notes: Tutorial line under the round progress bar, which is outlined and fills up once to show what it does. Said once, right before the first real board is played. One line, 20 px high, shrinks to fit 400 px.
fr: Remplis cette barre pour finir la manche.
de: Füll diesen Balken, um die Runde zu beenden.
pl: Napełnij ten pasek, by ukończyć rundę.
es: Llena esta barra para acabar la ronda.
ru: Заполни эту шкалу, чтобы пройти раунд.
tr: Turu bitirmek için bu çubuğu doldur.
ja: このバーをためるとラウンド終了。
zh-CN: 填满这个进度条就能过关。
ko: 이 막대를 채우면 라운드가 끝나요.

en: Every fish you pop fills it a little.
pt-BR: Cada peixe que você estoura enche um pouco.
notes: Smaller line under intro.tut.bar. Popping fish (making them burst in groups of 3 or more) scores points that fill the bar. One line, 16 px high, shrinks to fit 400 px.
fr: Chaque poisson éclaté la remplit un peu.
de: Jeder Fisch, den du platzen lässt, füllt ihn ein bisschen.
pl: Każda zbita ryba trochę go napełnia.
es: Cada pez que explotas la llena un poquito.
ru: Каждая лопнувшая рыба немного её заполняет.
tr: Patlattığın her balık onu biraz doldurur.
ja: 魚をはじくたびに少しずつたまる。
zh-CN: 你消除的每条鱼都会填上一点。
ko: 물고기를 터뜨릴 때마다 조금씩 차요.

en: Hey you! This is not JUST a match 3 game!
pt-BR: Ei, você! Isto não é SÓ um jogo de combinar 3!
notes: The first thing the old anglerfish ever says. He swims up and interrupts the floating line intro.line.match3 ("This is a match 3 game."), so it should read as him cutting in. JUST is stressed. Wraps in his box, two lines at most at 16 px, 384 px wide.
fr: Hé, toi ! Ce n'est pas JUSTE un jeu de match 3 !
de: Hey, du! Das ist nicht NUR ein Match-3-Spiel!
pl: Hej, ty! To nie TYLKO gra typu „połącz 3”!
es: ¡Eh, tú! ¡Esto no es SOLO un juego de combinar 3!
ru: Эй, ты! Это не ПРОСТО игра «три в ряд»!
tr: Hey sen! Bu SADECE bir 3’lü eşleştirme oyunu değil!
ja: ちょっと!これは「ただの」3マッチゲームじゃないよ!
zh-CN: 喂，你！这可不“只是”一款三消游戏！
ko: 어이! 이건 '그냥' 3매치 게임이 아니야!

en: See that? A fish looks the way you push it.
pt-BR: Viu só? O peixe olha para o lado em que você o empurra.
notes: The anglerfish, in the tutorial, after the first pop. Swapping a fish sideways turns it to face the way it moved. Two lines at most at 16 px, 384 px wide.
fr: Tu as vu ? Un poisson regarde du côté où tu le pousses.
de: Gesehen? Ein Fisch schaut dorthin, wohin du ihn schiebst.
pl: Widzisz? Ryba patrzy tam, dokąd ją pchniesz.
es: ¿Lo ves? Un pez mira hacia donde lo empujas.
ru: Видишь? Рыба смотрит туда, куда её толкнули.
tr: Gördün mü? Balık, ittiğin yöne bakar.
ja: 見た?魚は押した方を向くんだ。
zh-CN: 看见没？你往哪边推，鱼就看向哪边。
ko: 봤어? 물고기는 민 쪽을 바라봐.

en: Now these three all look the same way. Put them together.
pt-BR: Agora estes três olham para o mesmo lado. Junte-os.
notes: The anglerfish, in the tutorial, over a small board with three seahorses that all face the same way. Two lines at most at 16 px, 384 px wide.
fr: Ces trois-là regardent du même côté. Réunis-les.
de: Diese drei schauen in dieselbe Richtung. Bring sie zusammen.
pl: Te trzy patrzą w tę samą stronę. Połącz je.
es: Ahora estos tres miran hacia el mismo lado. Júntalos.
ru: Теперь эти три смотрят в одну сторону. Сведи их вместе.
tr: Şimdi bu üçü aynı yöne bakıyor. Onları bir araya getir.
ja: ほら、この3匹はみんな同じ方を向いてる。くっつけてごらん。
zh-CN: 现在这三条都看着同一个方向。把它们凑到一起。
ko: 이제 이 셋은 다 같은 쪽을 봐. 한데 모아 봐.

en: They did not pop. They left together. That is a school!
pt-BR: Eles não estouraram. Foram embora juntos. Isso é um cardume!
notes: The anglerfish, in the tutorial, right after the player's first school: three fish facing the same way swim off into the background instead of popping. School as in fish. Two lines at most at 16 px, 384 px wide.
fr: Ils n'ont pas éclaté. Ils sont partis ensemble. C'est un banc !
de: Sie sind nicht geplatzt. Sie sind zusammen weggeschwommen. Das ist ein Schwarm!
pl: Nie zbiły się. Odpłynęły razem. To ławica!
es: No explotaron. Se fueron juntos. ¡Eso es un banco!
ru: Они не лопнули. Они уплыли вместе. Это косяк!
tr: Patlamadılar. Birlikte gittiler. İşte bu bir sürü!
ja: はじけなかった。いっしょに出ていった。それが群れさ!
zh-CN: 它们没消除。它们一起走了。这就是鱼群！
ko: 안 터졌지? 같이 떠났어. 그게 물고기 떼야!

en: Want to know something? Look here. Push {dir} to look around.
pt-BR: Quer saber algo? Olhe aqui. Aperte {dir} para olhar em volta.
notes: The anglerfish, in the tutorial, just after info mode opens for the first time. Said in a narrow box beside the board: 118 px wide at 16 px, keep it short. No word over about 13 letters.
fr: Tu veux savoir quelque chose ? Regarde ici. Pousse {dir} pour regarder autour.
de: Willst du etwas wissen? Schau hier. Drück {dir}, um dich umzusehen.
pl: Chcesz coś wiedzieć? Patrz tutaj. Naciśnij {dir}, by się rozejrzeć.
es: ¿Quieres saber algo? Mira aquí. Pulsa {dir} para mirar.
ru: Хочешь что-то узнать? Смотри сюда. Жми {dir}, чтобы осмотреться.
tr: Bir şey mi öğrenmek istiyorsun? Buraya bak. Etrafa bakmak için {dir} it.
ja: 知りたい?ここを見て。{dir}で見まわせる。
zh-CN: 想知道点什么？看这里。推{dir}四处看看。
ko: 뭐 알고 싶어? 여기 봐. {dir}로 둘러봐.

en: What you find goes in the Codec. There is a lot more down here.
pt-BR: O que você achar vai para o Codec. Tem muito mais aqui embaixo.
notes: The anglerfish, in the tutorial, while info mode is open. The Codec is the in-game encyclopedia; use the same word as info.codec.title. It hints that the game has more than it shows. Narrow box beside the board: 118 px wide at 16 px.
fr: Ce que tu trouves va dans le Codex. Il y a bien plus en bas.
de: Was du findest, kommt in den Codex. Hier unten gibt es noch viel mehr.
pl: To, co znajdziesz, trafia do Kodeksu. Tu na dole jest dużo więcej.
es: Lo que encuentres va al Códec. Aquí abajo hay mucho más.
ru: Всё найденное попадает в Кодек. Тут внизу гораздо больше всего.
tr: Bulduğun şeyler Kodek’e girer. Burada çok daha fazlası var.
ja: 見つけたものは図鑑に入る。この下にはまだまだあるよ。
zh-CN: 你找到的东西都会进图鉴。下面还有好多呢。
ko: 찾은 건 코덱에 들어가. 여기 아래엔 훨씬 더 많아.

en: This sea can end a few ways. The rest is not free!
pt-BR: Este mar pode acabar de vários jeitos. O resto não é de graça!
notes: The anglerfish's last words of the tutorial, with question marks rising from the fish. It hints that the game has several endings, and that it will not give everything away (it sells information later). Narrow box beside the board: 118 px wide at 16 px.
fr: Cette mer peut finir de plusieurs façons. La suite n'est pas gratuite !
de: Dieses Meer kann auf mehrere Arten enden. Der Rest ist nicht umsonst!
pl: To morze może się skończyć na kilka sposobów. Reszta nie jest za darmo!
es: Este mar puede acabar de varias formas. ¡El resto no es gratis!
ru: Это море может кончиться по-разному. Остальное не бесплатно!
tr: Bu deniz birkaç şekilde bitebilir. Gerisi bedava değil!
ja: この海の終わり方はいくつかある。その先はタダじゃないよ!
zh-CN: 这片海有好几种结局。剩下的可不免费！
ko: 이 바다는 끝나는 길이 몇 개 있어. 나머진 공짜 아니야!

en: Easy, easy. I don't bite. Not anymore.
pt-BR: Calma, calma. Eu não mordo. Não mais.
notes: The anglerfish in the tutorial. Its voice: friendly but stingy, it has been hurt before and does not trust the player yet. Avoid words that need the speaker's or the player's gender. Two lines at most, 384 px wide at 16 px.
fr: Doucement, doucement. Je ne mords pas. Plus maintenant.
de: Ruhig, ganz ruhig. Ich beiße nicht. Nicht mehr.
pl: Spokojnie, spokojnie. Nie gryzę. Już nie.
es: Tranqui, tranqui. No muerdo. Ya no.
ru: Тише, тише. Я не кусаюсь. Уже нет.
tr: Yavaş, yavaş. Isırmam. Artık ısırmıyorum.
ja: まあまあ、落ち着いて。かみつかないよ。もうね。
zh-CN: 放轻松，放轻松。我不咬人。早就不咬了。
ko: 진정, 진정. 안 물어. 이제는.

en: I showed someone around down here once. That did not end well for me.
pt-BR: Já mostrei tudo aqui embaixo para alguém. Não acabou bem para mim.
notes: The anglerfish in the tutorial. Its voice: friendly but stingy, it has been hurt before and does not trust the player yet. Avoid words that need the speaker's or the player's gender. Two lines at most, 384 px wide at 16 px.
fr: J'ai déjà fait visiter le coin à quelqu'un. Ça a mal fini pour moi.
de: Ich habe hier unten schon mal jemanden herumgeführt. Das ging nicht gut für mich aus.
pl: Oprowadzałem tu kiedyś kogoś. Nie skończyło się to dla mnie dobrze.
es: Una vez le enseñé esto a alguien. No me salió bien.
ru: Однажды мне уже приходилось тут кому-то всё показывать. Для меня это плохо кончилось.
tr: Bir kez birine buraları gezdirmiştim. Benim için iyi bitmedi.
ja: 前にも一度、ここを案内したことがある。ろくな終わり方じゃなかったけど。
zh-CN: 我以前带人在这下面转过一次。结果对我可不太妙。
ko: 전에 누굴 여기 구경시켜 준 적 있어. 나한텐 끝이 안 좋았지.

en: You could use some help down here. And maybe I could too. We'll see.
pt-BR: Você precisa de ajuda aqui embaixo. E talvez eu também. Vamos ver.
notes: The anglerfish in the tutorial. Its voice: friendly but stingy, it has been hurt before and does not trust the player yet. Avoid words that need the speaker's or the player's gender. Two lines at most, 384 px wide at 16 px. It hints that the player may be able to help it later.
fr: Un coup de main te ferait du bien, ici. À moi aussi, peut-être. On verra.
de: Du könntest hier unten Hilfe brauchen. Ich vielleicht auch. Wir werden sehen.
pl: Przyda ci się tu pomoc. Mnie może też. Zobaczymy.
es: Aquí abajo te vendría bien ayuda. Y puede que a mí también. Ya veremos.
ru: Тебе тут пригодится помощь. А может, и мне. Посмотрим.
tr: Burada biraz yardım işine yarar. Belki benim de işime yarar. Göreceğiz.
ja: ここじゃ助けがいるだろう。こっちもかもね。まあ、様子を見よう。
zh-CN: 你在下面用得着帮手。说不定我也用得着。走着瞧吧。
ko: 여기선 도움이 좀 필요할 거야. 나도 그럴지 모르고. 두고 보자고.

en: There. Everybody gets that part for free.
pt-BR: Pronto. Essa parte todo mundo ganha de graça.
notes: The anglerfish in the tutorial. Its voice: friendly but stingy, it has been hurt before and does not trust the player yet. Avoid words that need the speaker's or the player's gender. Two lines at most, 384 px wide at 16 px. Right after the player's first pop.
fr: Voilà. Ça, tout le monde y a droit gratuitement.
de: Na also. Das gibt's für alle umsonst.
pl: No. To każdy dostaje za darmo.
es: Ahí está. Esa parte se la regalo a todo el mundo.
ru: Вот. Эту часть все получают бесплатно.
tr: İşte. O kısım herkese bedava.
ja: ほら。そこまでは誰でもタダだよ。
zh-CN: 瞧。这部分谁都能免费学会。
ko: 됐어. 거기까진 누구나 공짜로 알려 줘.

en: Watch which way they look. I won't say that twice.
pt-BR: Repare para onde eles olham. Não vou repetir.
notes: The anglerfish in the tutorial. Its voice: friendly but stingy, it has been hurt before and does not trust the player yet. Avoid words that need the speaker's or the player's gender. Two lines at most, 384 px wide at 16 px. About the way that the fish face.
fr: Regarde bien où ils regardent. Je ne le répéterai pas.
de: Achte darauf, wohin sie schauen. Das sage ich nicht zweimal.
pl: Patrz, w którą stronę patrzą. Nie powtórzę tego.
es: Fíjate hacia dónde miran. No lo repetiré.
ru: Следи, куда они смотрят. Дважды повторять не стану.
tr: Hangi yöne baktıklarına dikkat et. Bunu iki kez söylemem.
ja: 向きをよく見ておきな。二度は言わないよ。
zh-CN: 看好它们朝哪边看。这话我不说第二遍。
ko: 어느 쪽을 보는지 잘 봐. 두 번 말 안 해.

en: Most folks swim right past that. Keep it between us.
pt-BR: A maioria passa direto por isso. Fica entre nós.
notes: The anglerfish in the tutorial. Its voice: friendly but stingy, it has been hurt before and does not trust the player yet. Avoid words that need the speaker's or the player's gender. Two lines at most, 384 px wide at 16 px. After the player's first school.
fr: La plupart passent à côté. Ça reste entre nous.
de: Die meisten schwimmen einfach daran vorbei. Das bleibt unter uns.
pl: Większość przepływa obok i nie widzi. Niech to zostanie między nami.
es: Casi todo el mundo pasa de largo. Que quede entre nosotros.
ru: Большинство проплывает мимо. Пусть это останется между нами.
tr: Çoğu kişi bunun yanından geçip gider. Aramızda kalsın.
ja: たいていの連中は気づかず泳ぎ過ぎる。ここだけの話だよ。
zh-CN: 大多数家伙都直接游过去了。这事别外传。
ko: 다들 그건 그냥 지나쳐. 우리끼리 비밀이야.

en: Hm. You are not hopeless. Fine. I'll let you have a peek at the rest.
pt-BR: Hm. Ainda há esperança para você. Tá bom. Vou deixar você espiar o resto.
notes: The anglerfish in the tutorial. Its voice: friendly but stingy, it has been hurt before and does not trust the player yet. Avoid words that need the speaker's or the player's gender. Said in the narrow box beside the board: 118 px wide at 16 px, up to 8 lines.
fr: Hm. Tout n'est pas perdu avec toi. Bon. Je te laisse jeter un œil au reste.
de: Hm. Ganz hoffnungslos bist du nicht. Na gut. Ich lasse dich einen Blick auf den Rest werfen.
pl: Hm. Jednak jest z tobą jakaś nadzieja. Dobrze. Pozwolę ci zerknąć na resztę.
es: Hm. No lo haces nada mal. Vale. Te dejaré echar un vistazo al resto.
ru: Хм. Не всё потеряно. Ладно. Дам тебе взглянуть на остальное.
tr: Hım. Umutsuz vaka değilsin. Peki. Gerisine bir göz atmana izin vereyim.
ja: ふむ。見こみがなくもない。いいよ。残りもちょっとのぞかせてあげる。
zh-CN: 嗯。你还不算没救。行吧。剩下的让你偷看一眼。
ko: 흠. 아주 가망 없진 않네. 좋아. 나머지도 살짝 보여 줄게.

en: Do well, and maybe you can do something for me one day. Maybe.
pt-BR: Vá bem, e talvez um dia você possa fazer algo por mim. Talvez.
notes: The anglerfish in the tutorial. Its voice: friendly but stingy, it has been hurt before and does not trust the player yet. Avoid words that need the speaker's or the player's gender. Said in the narrow box beside the board: 118 px wide at 16 px, up to 8 lines. Its last words of the tutorial, before it swims off.
fr: Réussis, et un jour tu pourras peut-être faire quelque chose pour moi. Peut-être.
de: Mach deine Sache gut, dann kannst du vielleicht etwas für mich tun. Vielleicht.
pl: Radź sobie dobrze, a może kiedyś zrobisz coś dla mnie. Może.
es: Hazlo bien, y quizá algún día puedas hacer algo por mí. Quizá.
ru: Справься хорошо, и, может, однажды ты что-то сделаешь для меня. Может быть.
tr: İyi oyna, belki bir gün sen de benim için bir şey yaparsın. Belki.
ja: うまくやれたら、いつかこっちの頼みも聞いてもらえるかもね。かもね。
zh-CN: 好好干，也许哪天你能帮我做点事。也许吧。
ko: 잘하면 언젠가 날 위해 뭔가 해 줄 수 있을지도. 아마도.

en: Whoa, whoa. Breathe. In... and out. There is no rush down here.
pt-BR: Ei, ei. Respire. Inspira... e expira. Não há pressa aqui embaixo.
notes: The anglerfish in the tutorial. Its voice: a slightly annoying yoga instructor who knows everything about the sea and will teach the player, but wants them to relax first. Avoid words that need the player's gender. Two lines at most, 384 px wide at 16 px.
fr: Ho, ho. Respire. On inspire... on expire. Rien ne presse, ici.
de: Hoppla, hoppla. Atmen. Ein... und aus. Hier unten eilt nichts.
pl: Ho, ho. Oddychaj. Wdech... i wydech. Tu na dole nie ma pośpiechu.
es: Eh, eh. Respira. Dentro... y fuera. Aquí abajo no hay prisa.
ru: Тихо, тихо. Дыши. Вдох... и выдох. Тут внизу некуда спешить.
tr: Dur, dur. Nefes al. Ver... ve al. Burada acele yok.
ja: おっと、おっと。深呼吸。吸って…吐いて。ここでは急ぐことはないの。
zh-CN: 哇，哇。呼吸。吸……呼……这下面不用急。
ko: 워워, 워워. 숨 쉬어. 들이쉬고... 내쉬고. 여기선 서두를 거 없어.

en: I know everything about this sea. Everything! And I will teach you. Soon.
pt-BR: Eu sei tudo sobre este mar. Tudo! E vou ensinar a você. Em breve.
notes: The anglerfish in the tutorial. Its voice: a slightly annoying yoga instructor who knows everything about the sea and will teach the player, but wants them to relax first. Avoid words that need the player's gender. Two lines at most, 384 px wide at 16 px.
fr: Je sais tout sur cette mer. Tout ! Et je vais te l'apprendre. Bientôt.
de: Ich weiß alles über dieses Meer. Alles! Und ich bringe es dir bei. Bald.
pl: Wiem wszystko o tym morzu. Wszystko! I wszystkiego cię nauczę. Niedługo.
es: Sé todo sobre este mar. ¡Todo! Y te lo enseñaré. Pronto.
ru: Я знаю об этом море всё. Всё! И я тебя научу. Скоро.
tr: Bu deniz hakkında her şeyi bilirim. Her şeyi! Ve sana öğreteceğim. Yakında.
ja: この海のことは何でも知ってる。何でもよ!教えてあげる。もうすぐね。
zh-CN: 这片海的一切我都知道。一切！我会教你的。很快。
ko: 난 이 바다에 대해 다 알아. 전부! 그리고 가르쳐 줄게. 곧.

en: Oh! Lovely. Very calm. I felt that.
pt-BR: Oh! Que lindo. Muito calmo. Eu senti isso.
notes: The anglerfish in the tutorial. Its voice: a slightly annoying yoga instructor who knows everything about the sea and will teach the player, but wants them to relax first. Avoid words that need the player's gender. Two lines at most, 384 px wide at 16 px. Right after the first pop, when the player got it on the first swap.
fr: Oh ! Magnifique. Très calme. Je l'ai senti.
de: Oh! Wunderbar. Ganz ruhig. Das habe ich gespürt.
pl: Och! Pięknie. Bardzo spokojnie. Poczułem to.
es: ¡Oh! Precioso. Muy sereno. Lo he sentido.
ru: О! Чудесно. Очень спокойно. Это чувствуется.
tr: Oh! Harika. Çok sakin. Hissettim.
ja: まあ!すてき。とても穏やか。感じたわ。
zh-CN: 哦！真好。很平静。我感受到了。
ko: 오! 좋아. 아주 차분해. 느껴졌어.

en: There it is. See? No rush at all.
pt-BR: Aí está. Viu? Sem pressa nenhuma.
notes: The anglerfish in the tutorial. Its voice: a slightly annoying yoga instructor who knows everything about the sea and will teach the player, but wants them to relax first. Avoid words that need the player's gender. Two lines at most, 384 px wide at 16 px. Right after the first pop, when the player made other swaps first.
fr: Et voilà. Tu vois ? Aucune précipitation.
de: Da ist es. Siehst du? Ganz ohne Eile.
pl: No i jest. Widzisz? Bez żadnego pośpiechu.
es: Ahí está. ¿Ves? Ninguna prisa.
ru: Вот оно. Видишь? Совсем не нужно спешить.
tr: İşte oldu. Gördün mü? Hiç acele yok.
ja: そう、それ。ね?ちっとも急がなくていいの。
zh-CN: 这就对了。看到没？一点都不用急。
ko: 그렇지. 봤지? 서두를 거 하나도 없어.

en: Swaps that pop nothing cost a little multiplier. That is okay. Let it go.
pt-BR: Trocas que não estouram nada custam um pouco de multiplicador. Tudo bem. Deixe ir.
notes: The anglerfish in the tutorial. Its voice: a slightly annoying yoga instructor who knows everything about the sea and will teach the player, but wants them to relax first. Avoid words that need the player's gender. Two lines at most, 384 px wide at 16 px. Said only once in the whole tutorial.
fr: Les échanges qui n'éclatent rien coûtent un peu de multiplicateur. Ce n'est rien. Laisse aller.
de: Tausche, die nichts platzen lassen, kosten etwas Multiplikator. Schon gut. Lass los.
pl: Zamiany bez efektu kosztują trochę mnożnika. Nic się nie stało. Odpuść.
es: Los cambios que no explotan nada cuestan un poco de multiplicador. No pasa nada. Suéltalo.
ru: Обмен впустую стоит немного множителя. Это ничего. Отпусти.
tr: Hiçbir şey patlatmayan takaslar çarpandan biraz yer. Sorun değil. Bırak gitsin.
ja: 何もはじけない入れ替えは、倍率が少し下がる。いいのよ。手放して。
zh-CN: 什么都没消除的交换会扣一点倍率。没关系。放下吧。
ko: 아무것도 안 터지는 바꾸기는 배수가 조금 깎여. 괜찮아. 흘려보내.

en: Now, that seahorse way over there. Bring it home to the others. Slowly.
pt-BR: Agora, aquele cavalo-marinho lá longe. Traga-o até os outros. Devagar.
notes: The anglerfish in the tutorial. Its voice: a slightly annoying yoga instructor who knows everything about the sea and will teach the player, but wants them to relax first. Avoid words that need the player's gender. Two lines at most, 384 px wide at 16 px.
fr: Maintenant, cet hippocampe, là-bas. Ramène-le vers les autres. Lentement.
de: Und jetzt das Seepferdchen dort drüben. Bring es zu den anderen. Langsam.
pl: A teraz ten konik morski, tam daleko. Przyprowadź go do pozostałych. Powoli.
es: Ahora, ese caballito de mar de allá. Llévalo a casa con los otros. Despacio.
ru: А теперь тот морской конёк вон там. Приведи его домой к остальным. Медленно.
tr: Şimdi, şuradaki denizatı. Onu ötekilerin yanına, eve getir. Yavaşça.
ja: さて、あっちのタツノオトシゴ。仲間のところへ連れて帰って。ゆっくりね。
zh-CN: 现在，那边那只海马。把它带回同伴身边。慢慢来。
ko: 자, 저기 멀리 있는 해마. 다른 애들한테 데려다줘. 천천히.

en: Moving the cursor costs nothing. Wander. Enjoy the water.
pt-BR: Mover o cursor não custa nada. Passeie. Aproveite a água.
notes: The anglerfish in the tutorial. Its voice: a slightly annoying yoga instructor who knows everything about the sea and will teach the player, but wants them to relax first. Avoid words that need the player's gender. Two lines at most, 384 px wide at 16 px.
fr: Déplacer le curseur ne coûte rien. Promène-toi. Profite de l'eau.
de: Den Cursor zu bewegen kostet nichts. Schlendere. Genieß das Wasser.
pl: Ruch kursorem nic nie kosztuje. Pospaceruj. Ciesz się wodą.
es: Mover el cursor no cuesta nada. Pasea. Disfruta del agua.
ru: Двигать курсор ничего не стоит. Броди. Наслаждайся водой.
tr: İmleci oynatmak bedava. Dolaş. Suyun tadını çıkar.
ja: カーソルを動かすのはタダ。ただよって。水を楽しんで。
zh-CN: 移动光标不花任何东西。随便逛逛。享受海水。
ko: 커서를 움직이는 건 공짜야. 돌아다녀. 물을 즐겨.

en: See which way it looks now? Its friends look the other way. Hold that thought.
pt-BR: Viu para onde ele olha agora? Os amigos olham para o outro lado. Guarde essa ideia.
notes: The anglerfish in the tutorial. Its voice: a slightly annoying yoga instructor who knows everything about the sea and will teach the player, but wants them to relax first. Avoid words that need the player's gender. Two lines at most, 384 px wide at 16 px. While the player carries a seahorse to the left; the other two face right.
fr: Tu vois où il regarde ? Ses amis regardent de l'autre côté. Garde ça en tête.
de: Siehst du, wohin es jetzt schaut? Seine Freunde schauen andersherum. Merk dir das.
pl: Widzisz, gdzie teraz patrzy? Jego przyjaciele patrzą w drugą stronę. Zapamiętaj to.
es: ¿Ves hacia dónde mira ahora? Sus amigos miran al otro lado. Guarda esa idea.
ru: Видишь, куда он теперь смотрит? Его друзья смотрят в другую сторону. Запомни это.
tr: Şimdi hangi yöne baktığını gördün mü? Arkadaşları öbür yöne bakıyor. Bunu aklında tut.
ja: 今どっちを向いてるか見える?仲間は反対を向いてる。それ、覚えておいて。
zh-CN: 看见它现在朝哪边看了吗？它的朋友们朝另一边。记住这个念头。
ko: 이제 어느 쪽 보는지 알겠어? 친구들은 반대쪽을 봐. 그 생각 잠깐 품고 있어.

en: Mmm. They popped. Now, why was that? We will get there. Breathe.
pt-BR: Hmm. Eles estouraram. Por que será? Vamos chegar lá. Respire.
notes: The anglerfish in the tutorial. Its voice: a slightly annoying yoga instructor who knows everything about the sea and will teach the player, but wants them to relax first. Avoid words that need the player's gender. Two lines at most, 384 px wide at 16 px.
fr: Mmm. Ils ont éclaté. Pourquoi donc ? On y viendra. Respire.
de: Mmm. Sie sind geplatzt. Warum wohl? Dazu kommen wir noch. Atmen.
pl: Mmm. Zbiły się. Dlaczego? Dojdziemy do tego. Oddychaj.
es: Mmm. Explotaron. ¿Y por qué fue? Ya llegaremos. Respira.
ru: Ммм. Они лопнули. Почему же? Мы к этому придём. Дыши.
tr: Hımm. Patladılar. Peki, neden? Oraya geleceğiz. Nefes al.
ja: んー。はじけたね。さて、なぜでしょう?いずれわかるわ。深呼吸。
zh-CN: 嗯……它们消除了。那么，为什么呢？我们慢慢会讲到。呼吸。
ko: 음. 터졌네. 자, 왜 그랬을까? 곧 알게 돼. 숨 쉬어.

en: The same thing, but from the other side this time. Feel the difference.
pt-BR: A mesma coisa, mas agora do outro lado. Sinta a diferença.
notes: The anglerfish in the tutorial. Its voice: a slightly annoying yoga instructor who knows everything about the sea and will teach the player, but wants them to relax first. Avoid words that need the player's gender. Two lines at most, 384 px wide at 16 px.
fr: La même chose, mais de l'autre côté cette fois. Ressens la différence.
de: Dasselbe, aber diesmal von der anderen Seite. Spür den Unterschied.
pl: To samo, ale tym razem z drugiej strony. Poczuj różnicę.
es: Lo mismo, pero esta vez desde el otro lado. Siente la diferencia.
ru: То же самое, но теперь с другой стороны. Почувствуй разницу.
tr: Aynı şey, ama bu sefer öbür taraftan. Farkı hisset.
ja: 同じことを、今度は反対側から。ちがいを感じて。
zh-CN: 同样的事，这次从另一边来。感受一下区别。
ko: 똑같이, 이번엔 반대쪽에서. 차이를 느껴 봐.

en: Yes... now it looks the same way they do. Keep going.
pt-BR: Isso... agora ele olha para o mesmo lado que eles. Continue.
notes: The anglerfish in the tutorial. Its voice: a slightly annoying yoga instructor who knows everything about the sea and will teach the player, but wants them to relax first. Avoid words that need the player's gender. Two lines at most, 384 px wide at 16 px.
fr: Oui... maintenant il regarde du même côté qu'eux. Continue.
de: Ja... jetzt schaut es genauso wie sie. Mach weiter.
pl: Tak... teraz patrzy tam, gdzie one. Płyń dalej.
es: Sí... ahora mira hacia el mismo lado que ellos. Sigue.
ru: Да... теперь он смотрит туда же, куда они. Продолжай.
tr: Evet... şimdi onlarla aynı yöne bakıyor. Devam et.
ja: そう…これでみんなと同じ方を向いた。そのまま続けて。
zh-CN: 对……现在它和它们看向同一边了。继续。
ko: 그래... 이제 쟤들이랑 같은 쪽을 봐. 계속해.

en: Ah. They popped. You rushed. Breathe. Bring the lone one to the other two.
pt-BR: Ah. Eles estouraram. Você se apressou. Respire. Leve o sozinho até os outros dois.
notes: The anglerfish in the tutorial. Its voice: a slightly annoying yoga instructor who knows everything about the sea and will teach the player, but wants them to relax first. Avoid words that need the player's gender. Two lines at most, 384 px wide at 16 px. The last board popped where it should have been a school, and it comes in again.
fr: Ah. Ils ont éclaté. Trop vite. Respire. Amène celui qui est seul vers les deux autres.
de: Ah. Sie sind geplatzt. Zu eilig. Atmen. Bring das einzelne zu den anderen beiden.
pl: Ach. Zbiły się. Za szybko. Oddychaj. Przyprowadź samotnego do pozostałych dwóch.
es: Ah. Explotaron. Te precipitaste. Respira. Lleva el solitario con los otros dos.
ru: Ах. Они лопнули. Слишком спешно. Дыши. Приведи одиночку к двум другим.
tr: Ah. Patladılar. Acele ettin. Nefes al. Yalnız olanı öbür ikisine getir.
ja: あら。はじけちゃった。急いだね。深呼吸。ひとりの子を、ほかの2匹のところへ。
zh-CN: 啊。它们消除了。你太急了。呼吸。把落单的那只带到另外两只身边。
ko: 아. 터졌네. 서둘렀어. 숨 쉬어. 혼자 있는 애를 다른 둘한테 데려가.

en: Quick! You know you can go slower, right?
pt-BR: Rápido! Você sabe que pode ir mais devagar, né?
notes: The anglerfish in the tutorial. Its voice: a slightly annoying yoga instructor who knows everything about the sea and will teach the player, but wants them to relax first. Avoid words that need the player's gender. Two lines at most, 384 px wide at 16 px.
fr: Rapide ! Tu sais que tu peux ralentir, hein ?
de: Schnell! Du weißt schon, dass es auch langsamer geht?
pl: Szybko! Wiesz, że można wolniej?
es: ¡Qué rapidez! Sabes que puedes ir más despacio, ¿verdad?
ru: Быстро! Ты ведь знаешь, что можно медленнее?
tr: Hızlısın! Daha yavaş gidebileceğini biliyorsun, değil mi?
ja: 速い!もっとゆっくりでもいいって、知ってる?
zh-CN: 好快！你知道可以慢一点的，对吧？
ko: 빠르네! 더 천천히 해도 되는 거 알지?

en: Lovely and slow. That is what I like to see.
pt-BR: Bem devagar. É disso que eu gosto.
notes: The anglerfish in the tutorial. Its voice: a slightly annoying yoga instructor who knows everything about the sea and will teach the player, but wants them to relax first. Avoid words that need the player's gender. Two lines at most, 384 px wide at 16 px.
fr: Tout en douceur. C'est ce que j'aime voir.
de: Schön langsam. So sehe ich das gern.
pl: Ładnie i powoli. To lubię widzieć.
es: Precioso y lento. Eso es lo que me gusta ver.
ru: Чудесно и медленно. Вот это мне нравится.
tr: Güzel ve yavaş. İşte görmek istediğim bu.
ja: すてきにゆっくり。そういうのが見たかったの。
zh-CN: 又好又慢。我就喜欢看这个。
ko: 좋아, 천천히. 그게 내가 보고 싶은 거야.

en: I could tell you so much more about that. And I will. Soon.
pt-BR: Eu poderia contar muito mais sobre isso. E vou. Em breve.
notes: The anglerfish in the tutorial. Its voice: a slightly annoying yoga instructor who knows everything about the sea and will teach the player, but wants them to relax first. Avoid words that need the player's gender. Two lines at most, 384 px wide at 16 px.
fr: Je pourrais t'en dire tellement plus. Et je le ferai. Bientôt.
de: Ich könnte dir so viel mehr darüber erzählen. Und das werde ich. Bald.
pl: Mógłbym powiedzieć o tym dużo więcej. I powiem. Niedługo.
es: Podría contarte mucho más sobre eso. Y lo haré. Pronto.
ru: Я могу рассказать об этом гораздо больше. И расскажу. Скоро.
tr: Sana bununla ilgili çok daha fazlasını anlatabilirim. Anlatacağım da. Yakında.
ja: それについてはもっと話せるけど。話すわ。もうすぐね。
zh-CN: 这个我还能跟你讲好多好多。我会讲的。很快。
ko: 그것에 대해 할 얘기가 훨씬 많아. 해 줄게. 곧.

en: Not yet! Relax. I will show you soon.
pt-BR: Ainda não! Relaxe. Vou mostrar em breve.
notes: The anglerfish in the tutorial. Its voice: a slightly annoying yoga instructor who knows everything about the sea and will teach the player, but wants them to relax first. Avoid words that need the player's gender. Two lines at most, 384 px wide at 16 px. The player pressed the info key too early.
fr: Pas encore ! Détends-toi. Je te montrerai bientôt.
de: Noch nicht! Entspann dich. Ich zeige es dir bald.
pl: Jeszcze nie! Spokojnie. Niedługo ci pokażę.
es: ¡Todavía no! Relájate. Pronto te lo enseño.
ru: Ещё рано! Расслабься. Скоро покажу.
tr: Daha değil! Rahatla. Yakında göstereceğim.
ja: まだよ!リラックス。もうすぐ見せてあげる。
zh-CN: 还没到时候！放松。我很快就给你看。
ko: 아직 아니야! 긴장 풀어. 곧 보여 줄게.

en: Soon. Soon. In... and out.
pt-BR: Em breve. Em breve. Inspira... e expira.
notes: The anglerfish in the tutorial. Its voice: a slightly annoying yoga instructor who knows everything about the sea and will teach the player, but wants them to relax first. Avoid words that need the player's gender. Two lines at most, 384 px wide at 16 px. The player pressed the info key too early, a second time.
fr: Bientôt. Bientôt. On inspire... on expire.
de: Bald. Bald. Ein... und aus.
pl: Niedługo. Niedługo. Wdech... i wydech.
es: Pronto. Pronto. Dentro... y fuera.
ru: Скоро. Скоро. Вдох... и выдох.
tr: Yakında. Yakında. Al... ve ver.
ja: もうすぐ。もうすぐ。吸って…吐いて。
zh-CN: 很快。很快。吸……呼……
ko: 곧. 곧. 들이쉬고... 내쉬고.

en: No rush. No rush at all. I will wait. I am very good at waiting.
pt-BR: Sem pressa. Nenhuma pressa. Eu espero. Sou ótimo em esperar.
notes: The anglerfish in the tutorial. Its voice: a slightly annoying yoga instructor who knows everything about the sea and will teach the player, but wants them to relax first. Avoid words that need the player's gender. Two lines at most, 384 px wide at 16 px. The player has not pressed anything for a while.
fr: Rien ne presse. Vraiment rien. J'attends. Je suis très doué pour ça.
de: Keine Eile. Überhaupt keine. Ich warte. Darin bin ich sehr gut.
pl: Bez pośpiechu. Żadnego. Poczekam. Jestem w tym bardzo dobry.
es: Sin prisa. Ninguna prisa. Esperaré. Se me da muy bien esperar.
ru: Не спеши. Совсем не спеши. Я подожду. Ждать я умею очень хорошо.
tr: Acele yok. Hiç acele yok. Beklerim. Beklemede çok iyiyimdir.
ja: 急がない。ちっとも急がない。待つわ。待つのはとても得意なの。
zh-CN: 不急。一点都不急。我会等。我最擅长等了。
ko: 서두를 거 없어. 하나도. 기다릴게. 기다리는 건 아주 잘해.

en: You are doing great. Deep breath. Now you may look around.
pt-BR: Você está indo muito bem. Respire fundo. Agora pode olhar em volta.
notes: The anglerfish in the tutorial. Its voice: a slightly annoying yoga instructor who knows everything about the sea and will teach the player, but wants them to relax first. Avoid words that need the player's gender. Said in the narrow box beside the board: 118 px wide at 16 px, up to 8 lines.
fr: Tu t'en sors très bien. Grande inspiration. Tu peux regarder autour.
de: Das machst du großartig. Tief durchatmen. Jetzt darfst du dich umsehen.
pl: Świetnie ci idzie. Głęboki oddech. Teraz możesz się rozejrzeć.
es: Lo haces genial. Respira hondo. Ahora puedes mirar.
ru: У тебя отлично выходит. Глубокий вдох. Теперь можно осмотреться.
tr: Harika gidiyorsun. Derin nefes. Şimdi etrafa bakabilirsin.
ja: とてもいい調子。深呼吸。もう見まわしていいよ。
zh-CN: 你做得很棒。深呼吸。现在你可以四处看看了。
ko: 아주 잘하고 있어. 크게 숨 쉬고. 이제 둘러봐도 돼.

en: What you find goes in the Codec. I know what is in there. All of it. Patience.
pt-BR: O que você achar vai para o Codec. Eu sei o que tem lá. Tudo. Paciência.
notes: The anglerfish in the tutorial. Its voice: a slightly annoying yoga instructor who knows everything about the sea and will teach the player, but wants them to relax first. Avoid words that need the player's gender. Said in the narrow box beside the board: 118 px wide at 16 px, up to 8 lines. Use the same word as info.codec.title.
fr: Ce que tu trouves va dans le Codex. Je sais ce qu'il contient. Tout. Patience.
de: Was du findest, kommt in den Codex. Ich weiß, was drinsteht. Alles. Geduld.
pl: To, co znajdziesz, trafia do Kodeksu. Wiem, co tam jest. Wszystko. Cierpliwości.
es: Lo que encuentres va al Códec. Sé lo que hay dentro. Todo. Paciencia.
ru: Всё найденное попадает в Кодек. Я знаю, что там. Всё. Терпение.
tr: Bulduğun şeyler Kodek’e girer. İçinde ne olduğunu bilirim. Hepsini. Sabır.
ja: 見つけたものは図鑑に入る。中身は知ってる。全部ね。がまんして。
zh-CN: 你找到的东西都会进图鉴。里面有什么我都知道。全部。耐心点。
ko: 찾은 건 코덱에 들어가. 거기 뭐가 있는지 난 알아. 전부 다. 참아.

en: This sea can end a few ways. I will tell you. Soon. Breathe.
pt-BR: Este mar pode acabar de vários jeitos. Vou contar. Em breve. Respire.
notes: The anglerfish in the tutorial. Its voice: a slightly annoying yoga instructor who knows everything about the sea and will teach the player, but wants them to relax first. Avoid words that need the player's gender. Said in the narrow box beside the board: 118 px wide at 16 px, up to 8 lines. It hints that the game has several endings.
fr: Cette mer peut finir de plusieurs façons. Je te dirai. Bientôt. Respire.
de: Dieses Meer kann auf mehrere Arten enden. Ich sage es dir. Bald. Atmen.
pl: To morze może się skończyć na kilka sposobów. Powiem ci. Niedługo. Oddychaj.
es: Este mar puede acabar de varias formas. Te lo diré. Pronto. Respira.
ru: Это море может кончиться по-разному. Я расскажу. Скоро. Дыши.
tr: Bu deniz birkaç şekilde bitebilir. Anlatacağım. Yakında. Nefes al.
ja: この海の終わり方はいくつかある。教えてあげる。もうすぐ。深呼吸。
zh-CN: 这片海有好几种结局。我会告诉你的。很快。呼吸。
ko: 이 바다는 끝나는 길이 몇 개 있어. 알려 줄게. 곧. 숨 쉬어.

en: Fish go up and down too, you know. Look around. See what you find.
pt-BR: Peixes também vão para cima e para baixo. Olhe em volta. Veja o que encontra.
notes: The anglerfish in the tutorial. Its voice: a slightly annoying yoga instructor who knows everything about the sea, but wants the player to relax first. Two lines at most, 384 px wide at 16 px. The board where the player makes the first vertical swap.
fr: Les poissons vont aussi en haut et en bas. Regarde bien. Vois ce que tu trouves.
de: Fische gehen auch hoch und runter. Schau dich um. Mal sehen, was du findest.
pl: Ryby ruszają się też w górę i w dół. Rozejrzyj się. Zobacz, co znajdziesz.
es: Los peces también van arriba y abajo, ¿sabes? Mira a tu alrededor. A ver qué encuentras.
ru: Рыбы ходят и вверх-вниз, знаешь ли. Осмотрись. Глянь, что найдёшь.
tr: Balıklar yukarı aşağı da gider, biliyorsun. Etrafa bak. Ne bulacaksın gör.
ja: 魚は上や下にも動くのよ。見まわして。何が見つかるかな。
zh-CN: 鱼也可以上下换，你知道吧。四处看看。看你能发现什么。
ko: 물고기는 위아래로도 움직여, 알지? 둘러봐. 뭐가 있나 봐.

en: Mmm. Let that one sink in.
pt-BR: Hmm. Deixe isso assentar.
notes: The anglerfish in the tutorial. Its voice: a slightly annoying yoga instructor who knows everything about the sea, but wants the player to relax first. Two lines at most, 384 px wide at 16 px. Right after it says that fish do not need to be in straight lines.
fr: Mmm. Laisse ça infuser.
de: Mmm. Lass das mal sacken.
pl: Mmm. Niech to do ciebie dotrze.
es: Mmm. Deja que eso cale hondo.
ru: Ммм. Дай этому улечься.
tr: Hımm. Bunu bir sindir.
ja: んー。じっくりしみこませて。
zh-CN: 嗯……让这句话慢慢沉下去，好好消化。
ko: 음. 그 말, 천천히 스며들게 둬.

en: Ha! Don't believe everything you read.
pt-BR: Ha! Não acredite em tudo o que você lê.
notes: The anglerfish in the tutorial. Its voice: a slightly annoying yoga instructor who knows everything about the sea, but wants the player to relax first. Two lines at most, 384 px wide at 16 px. Its very first line, cutting off the floating text 'This is a match 3 game.' It is incredulous.
fr: Ha ! Ne crois pas tout ce que tu lis.
de: Ha! Glaub nicht alles, was du liest.
pl: Ha! Nie wierz we wszystko, co czytasz.
es: ¡Ja! No te creas todo lo que lees.
ru: Ха! Не верь всему, что читаешь.
tr: Ha! Okuduğun her şeye inanma.
ja: はっ!書いてあることを全部信じちゃだめ。
zh-CN: 哈！别你读到什么就信什么。
ko: 하! 읽는 걸 다 믿지는 마.

en: Hey you! This is not {bounce}JUST{end} a match 3 game!
pt-BR: Ei, você! Isto não é {bounce}SÓ{end} um jogo de combinar 3!
notes: The anglerfish in the tutorial. Its voice: a slightly annoying yoga instructor who knows everything about the sea, but wants the player to relax first. Two lines at most, 384 px wide at 16 px. Keep the {tags} around the same word: they style it ({gold} colors it, {bounce} makes it bounce, {bold} makes it bold, {end} stops).
fr: Hé, toi ! Ce n'est pas {bounce}JUSTE{end} un jeu de match 3 !
de: Hey, du! Das ist nicht {bounce}NUR{end} ein Match-3-Spiel!
pl: Hej, ty! To nie {bounce}TYLKO{end} gra typu „połącz 3”!
es: ¡Eh, tú! ¡Esto no es {bounce}SOLO{end} un juego de combinar 3!
ru: Эй, ты! Это не {bounce}ПРОСТО{end} игра «три в ряд»!
tr: Hey sen! Bu {bounce}SADECE{end} bir 3’lü eşleştirme oyunu değil!
ja: ちょっと!これは{bounce}ただの{end}3マッチゲームじゃないよ!
zh-CN: 喂，你！这可不{bounce}只是{end}一款三消游戏！
ko: 어이! 이건 {bounce}그냥{end} 3매치 게임이 아니야!

en: They did not pop. They left together. That is a {gold}school{end}!
pt-BR: Eles não estouraram. Foram embora juntos. Isso é um {gold}cardume{end}!
notes: The anglerfish in the tutorial. Its voice: a slightly annoying yoga instructor who knows everything about the sea, but wants the player to relax first. Two lines at most, 384 px wide at 16 px. Keep the {tags} around the same word: they style it ({gold} colors it, {bounce} makes it bounce, {bold} makes it bold, {end} stops). School as in fish. Right after the player's first school.
fr: Ils n'ont pas éclaté. Ils sont partis ensemble. C'est un {gold}banc{end} !
de: Sie sind nicht geplatzt. Sie sind zusammen weggeschwommen. Das ist ein {gold}Schwarm{end}!
pl: Nie zbiły się. Odpłynęły razem. To {gold}ławica{end}!
es: No explotaron. Se fueron juntos. ¡Eso es un {gold}banco{end}!
ru: Они не лопнули. Они уплыли вместе. Это {gold}косяк{end}!
tr: Patlamadılar. Birlikte gittiler. İşte bu bir {gold}sürü{end}!
ja: はじけなかった。いっしょに出ていった。それが{gold}群れ{end}よ!
zh-CN: 它们没消除。它们一起走了。这就是{gold}鱼群{end}！
ko: 안 터졌지? 같이 떠났어. 그게 {gold}물고기 떼{end}야!

en: This is your {gold}move{end} count. Every swap adds one. Fewer is better.
pt-BR: Este é o seu total de {gold}jogadas{end}. Cada troca soma uma. Menos é melhor.
notes: The anglerfish in the tutorial. Its voice: a slightly annoying yoga instructor who knows everything about the sea, but wants the player to relax first. Two lines at most, 384 px wide at 16 px. Keep the {tags} around the same word: they style it ({gold} colors it, {bounce} makes it bounce, {bold} makes it bold, {end} stops). Said beside the Moves counter, the first time that it appears. Use the same word for moves as the Moves label.
fr: Voici ton compteur de {gold}coups{end}. Chaque échange en ajoute un. Moins, c'est mieux.
de: Das ist dein {gold}Zugzähler{end}. Jeder Tausch zählt eins. Weniger ist besser.
pl: To twój licznik {gold}ruchów{end}. Każda zamiana dodaje jeden. Im mniej, tym lepiej.
es: Este es tu contador de {gold}jugadas{end}. Cada cambio suma una. Cuantas menos, mejor.
ru: Это счётчик {gold}ходов{end}. Каждый обмен добавляет один. Чем меньше, тем лучше.
tr: Bu senin {gold}hamle{end} sayın. Her takas bir ekler. Az olan iyidir.
ja: これが{gold}手数{end}。入れ替えるたびに1増える。少ないほどいい。
zh-CN: 这是你的{gold}步数{end}。每次交换加一。越少越好。
ko: 이건 네 {gold}이동{end} 횟수야. 바꿀 때마다 하나씩. 적을수록 좋아.

en: This is your {gold}multiplier{end}. Pop fish, and it climbs, and everything scores more.
pt-BR: Este é o seu {gold}multiplicador{end}. Estoure peixes, ele sobe, e tudo vale mais.
notes: The anglerfish in the tutorial. Its voice: a slightly annoying yoga instructor who knows everything about the sea, but wants the player to relax first. Two lines at most, 384 px wide at 16 px. Keep the {tags} around the same word: they style it ({gold} colors it, {bounce} makes it bounce, {bold} makes it bold, {end} stops). Said beside the Multiplier, the first time that it appears.
fr: Voici ton {gold}multiplicateur{end}. Fais éclater des poissons, il monte, et tout rapporte plus.
de: Das ist dein {gold}Multiplikator{end}. Lass Fische platzen, er steigt, und alles zählt mehr.
pl: To twój {gold}mnożnik{end}. Zbijaj ryby, a rośnie i wszystko daje więcej punktów.
es: Este es tu {gold}multiplicador{end}. Explota peces, y sube, y todo puntúa más.
ru: Это твой {gold}множитель{end}. Лопай рыб, и он растёт, и всё приносит больше очков.
tr: Bu senin {gold}çarpanın{end}. Balık patlat, yükselsin, her şey daha çok puan getirsin.
ja: これが{gold}倍率{end}。魚をはじくと上がって、全部の得点が増える。
zh-CN: 这是你的{gold}倍率{end}。消除鱼，它就会涨，所有得分都更高。
ko: 이건 네 {gold}배수{end}야. 물고기를 터뜨리면 오르고, 모든 점수가 커져.

en: And these are your {gold}rounds{end}. {$rounds} of them. Plenty of time.
pt-BR: E estas são as suas {gold}rodadas{end}. São {$rounds}. Tempo de sobra.
notes: The anglerfish in the tutorial, in the narrow box beside the board (118 px wide at 16 px, up to 8 lines), beside the Rounds Left counter. Keep the {tags} around the same word: they style it ({gold} colors it, {bounce} makes it bounce, {bold} makes it bold, {end} stops).
fr: Et voici tes {gold}manches{end}. Il y en a {$rounds}. Tout ton temps.
de: Und das sind deine {gold}Runden{end}. {$rounds} Stück. Zeit genug.
pl: A to twoje {gold}rundy{end}. Jest ich {$rounds}. Mnóstwo czasu.
es: Y estas son tus {gold}rondas{end}. {$rounds}. Tiempo de sobra.
ru: А это твои {gold}раунды{end}. Всего: {$rounds}. Времени полно.
tr: Bunlar da senin {gold}turların{end}. Tam {$rounds} tane. Bol bol vakit.
ja: そしてこれが{gold}ラウンド{end}。全部で{$rounds}。時間はたっぷり。
zh-CN: 这些是你的{gold}回合{end}。一共{$rounds}个。时间多得是。
ko: 그리고 이건 네 {gold}라운드{end}. {$rounds}개나 있어. 시간은 넉넉해.

en: I am going to {bold}reset{end} your moves, now. That was all practice.
pt-BR: Vou {bold}zerar{end} suas jogadas agora. Aquilo tudo foi treino.
notes: The anglerfish in the tutorial. Its voice: a slightly annoying yoga instructor who knows everything about the sea, but wants the player to relax first. Two lines at most, 384 px wide at 16 px. Keep the {tags} around the same word: they style it ({gold} colors it, {bounce} makes it bounce, {bold} makes it bold, {end} stops). Right before the Moves counter goes back to 0, at the end of the tutorial.
fr: Je vais {bold}remettre{end} tes coups à zéro. Tout ça, c'était pour t'entraîner.
de: Ich setze deine Züge jetzt {bold}zurück{end}. Das war alles nur Übung.
pl: Teraz {bold}wyzeruję{end} twoje ruchy. To był tylko trening.
es: Ahora voy a {bold}reiniciar{end} tus jugadas. Todo eso era práctica.
ru: Сейчас я {bold}обнулю{end} твои ходы. Это была тренировка.
tr: Şimdi hamlelerini {bold}sıfırlayacağım{end}. O hepsi alıştırmaydı.
ja: じゃあ、手数を{bold}リセット{end}するね。今のは全部練習。
zh-CN: 我现在要把你的步数{bold}清零{end}了。刚才都是练习。
ko: 이제 네 이동을 {bold}초기화{end}할게. 다 연습이었어.

en: Upgrades come in two kinds. {gold}Passives{end} just work, all the time.
pt-BR: Há dois tipos de melhoria. {gold}Passivas{end} simplesmente funcionam, o tempo todo.
notes: The anglerfish in the tutorial. Its voice: a slightly annoying yoga instructor who knows everything about the sea, but wants the player to relax first. Two lines at most, 384 px wide at 16 px. Keep the {tags} around the same word: they style it ({gold} colors it, {bounce} makes it bounce, {bold} makes it bold, {end} stops). Alone on a dark screen, before the first upgrade cards appear. Use the same word as the Passive label on a card.
fr: Il y a deux sortes d'améliorations. Les {gold}passifs{end} marchent tout seuls, tout le temps.
de: Es gibt zwei Arten von Upgrades. {gold}Passive{end} wirken einfach, die ganze Zeit.
pl: Są dwa rodzaje ulepszeń. {gold}Pasywne{end} po prostu działają, cały czas.
es: Hay dos tipos de mejoras. Las {gold}pasivas{end} simplemente funcionan, siempre.
ru: Улучшения бывают двух видов. {gold}Пассивные{end} просто работают, всегда.
tr: Yükseltmelerin iki türü var. {gold}Pasifler{end} hep kendi kendine çalışır.
ja: 強化には2種類ある。{gold}パッシブ{end}はずっと勝手に効く。
zh-CN: 升级分两种。{gold}被动{end}一直自己生效。
ko: 업그레이드는 두 종류야. {gold}패시브{end}는 늘 알아서 작동해.

en: {gold}Moves{end} are special swaps. Hold their button, push a way, then let them recharge.
pt-BR: {gold}Golpes{end} são trocas especiais. Segure o botão, empurre, e deixe recarregar.
notes: The anglerfish in the tutorial. Its voice: a slightly annoying yoga instructor who knows everything about the sea, but wants the player to relax first. Two lines at most, 384 px wide at 16 px. Keep the {tags} around the same word: they style it ({gold} colors it, {bounce} makes it bounce, {bold} makes it bold, {end} stops). Alone on a dark screen, before the first upgrade cards appear.
